blocks.text: Tijuca Forest offers a different perspective on Rio. The jeep takes you through dense, humid forest, past small waterfalls, and you may spot monkeys and birds by the roadside. On foot, you can explore the forest at a leisurely pace before taking in more views of Rio from the Vista Chinesa lookout. You can spend the morning in a city by the ocean and find yourself amid tropical vegetation a few hours later.

blocks.text: On car-free Ilha Grande, you get between bays by boat or along walking trails. The boat trip follows the forested coast, passing small islands and beaches that are easier to reach from the water. You can snorkel in the clear bays, where you may see sea turtles, dolphins and large tropical fish.
